en: A colorized vintage postcard depicting a domed, circular structure supported by columns in a park-like setting, likely a fountain or mausoleum. There are several trees surrounding the monument, and another neoclassical building structure visible to the right. The caption on the top left includes French and English text referencing 'Salonique' (the French name for Thessaloniki) and Saint George's Church, formerly a mosque.
